verdict.rationale: RevenueCat documents its own scheduled data exports, which deliver app data to cloud storage or email, so a native export path exists. The evidence does not name the export format or show that the exports cover all data. The CustomerInfo object and REST API offer only per-customer retrieval, not a bulk exit path. Missing for 10: documented open export formats (e.g. CSV/JSON schema), confirmation that the exports cover all account data (products, entitlements, transactions, configuration), a documented one-off full export or offboarding path, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: RevenueCat delivers your apps' data to a cloud storage provider or to email on a schedule you control.
The CustomerInfo object contains all of the purchase and subscription data available about a customer.
